exposure: Risk Adjustment in Congenital Heart Surgery (RACHS-1) scores
cohort: 78 neonates with congenital heart disease who were diagnosed and treated with postoperative infection and 78 age- and sex-matched non-infected neonates
finding: Low oxygen saturation, prolonged catheterization, and prolonged ICU stay were independent risk factors for postoperative infection in neonates with congenital heart disease undergoing cardiac surgery.
birth_weight: Neonates with postoperative infection had lower birth weight than those without infection.
